name: The Third Auditor
summary: Three Auditors of Tributes may sit at once and the fourth is refused on capacity, which is a different refusal from a single seat's occupied and produces a different situation for whoever is refused. It exists because an audit nobody can replace is a private accounting rather than an office.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/march_of_the_nine_provinces.tres office_auditor capacity=3 naming_body=the_reeve
abstract-pattern:collegiate audit offices distinguishing seat-occupied from capacity-full
lore search auditor / capacity / ledger returned no prior politics record

attributes.recognition_currently_projects_nothing: both entries are authored at 0.0, so the office that reads accounts is the office least able to be rewarded for reading them well

two_refusals_kept_apart.seat_occupied: the position's cap is 1, so the seat itself is taken
two_refusals_kept_apart.capacity_full: the cap is greater than 1 and an overflow is a refused admit, never a silent trim

attributes.why_the_distinction_is_a_rule: the two produce different situations for whoever is refused. A single seat says there is one of this; a full capacity says there are three and you are the fourth. Collapsing them would make one of the two statements unmakeable
attributes.why_three: reading a ledger is the one act an office can perform and still be mistrusted for, so it is done by a body that its own peers can outvote, and a body of two would simply reproduce the private accounting it replaced
attributes.who_names_them: an office appointed by an office, which is the whole cycle. The audit's independence is not the appointment - it is the refusal on capacity and the asymmetry below
attributes.asymmetry: an auditor cannot expel an equal or above, and the standing cost of an inquisition is strictly higher for the expeller than for the expelled. That asymmetry is what makes an audit a political act rather than an administrative one

name: The Crown Claim
summary: The Court of the Star's crown claim. Position is the discrete authored id 'crown'; standing is 95 earned points against an authored ceiling of 150; the only obligation it carries is one term of court etiquette. The crown has the higher standing in the setting and the worse claim by its own measure - 0.633 of its ceiling against the March's 0.667 - which is the whole reason two polities can each believe they are the senior party.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/court_of_the_star.tres claim_court
abstract-pattern:succession claims whose prestige and ledger position disagree
lore search crown / claim / standing returned no prior politics record

attributes.position_kind: discrete, authored, a .tres id and never an index into a ladder
attributes.invisible_range: 50 of the 150 possible points project nothing at all - a third of the crown's politics is held in a currency no mechanism can read
attributes.the_obligation_is_a_form_of_address: the only claim in the setting whose price is how a person is spoken to, which is also the only one a claimant can pay while owing nothing material
attributes.the_disagreement_is_the_point: 95 of 150 reads worse than 80 of 120. Absolute standing puts the crown first; the crown's own normalized ratio puts it second. Neither reading can be derived from the other, so the two polities are not mistaken about each other - they are measuring different things.
attributes.writes_position_from: a named heir who has then held a year and been confirmed by the court; the gap between being named and being confirmed is the entire content of the claim
attributes.writes_standing_from: settled performance at court, read as periods and never as a clock the court may read for itself
forbidden_derivations: a higher standing treated as evidence of a better claim
grants: access, to a doctrine tier and a precedent shelf
attributes.comparison_to_the_march: reads above the March on absolute standing and below it on its own normalized ratio, so neither polity can prove seniority and the argument is structural rather than a matter of bad arithmetic

name: The Petition on Graded Cloth
summary: An unanswered petition asking which of two published exclusivities governs a traveller's cloth, filed by a credential culture against a house that publishes technique, attendance and a chamber in exchange for discretion. It exists because the road's rule and the house's rule cannot both hold, and neither derives from the other: road standing is earned by crossing, the house's exclusivity is published and unfalsifiable.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:cultures.passage_livery vs organizations.quiethouse published exclusivity vs cultures.quiet_count
abstract-pattern:two credential systems with incompatible admission tests
lore search treaty / exclusivity / petition returned no prior politics record

attributes.the_conflict: the road reads a traveller's cloth as the only thing about a stranger anyone can check, and the house declines to write down what was done inside it - so the road cannot check anything at all about a member of the house, including whether the member crossed with the right cloth
attributes.why_no_body_can_settle_it: the request on the table is to make one standing derive from the other. Granting a position for standing, or standing for a position, is precisely the failure the whole institution model exists to prevent, so a body that could settle it does not exist and a body that could is not competent to
attributes.the_only_available_outcome: recognition - a bounded percent, an access shelf, and a fit that projects nothing. Neither party wants it, which is why the petition is still open four generations after the house published its exclusivity
attributes.unresolved_since: the house has published exclusivity for four generations, and cultures.passage_livery has been on the road for at least two
attributes.the_third_answer_that_works: a licence nobody issues. A traveller is legible and nothing about them is knowable, and the road already survives on exactly that arrangement - which is why the petition's failure is informative rather than merely unresolved
attributes.what_would_resolve_it: nothing that does not make one axis derive from the other. Any answer to this petition is a decision about the institution model rather than about the road

name: The March Claim
summary: The March of the Nine Provinces' institutional claim. Position and standing are two numbers and neither reads the other: position is the discrete authored id 'march', written only by a completed trial, and standing is 80 earned points clamped at 120, moved only by ford dues actually settled. It grants recognition and access and never power.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/march_of_the_nine_provinces.tres claim_march
abstract-pattern:institution claims as position plus earned standing plus obligation lines
lore search claim / standing / office / succession returned no prior politics record

attributes.position_kind: discrete, authored, a .tres id and never an index into a ladder
attributes.invisible_range: the last 20 points of the ceiling project exactly nothing, so a sixth of the March's political range is real politics with no mechanical expression at all
attributes.writes_position_from: a completed trial only, and the trial that writes it is one the writing office cannot judge
attributes.writes_standing_from: dues actually settled, one explicit periods argument per accrual - no record in this institution reads a clock, and every accrual is told how many periods it is being asked about
never_reads_the_other: a promotion does not move standing
a settled debt does not write a position
a vacancy does not read as standing zero
an obligation being open does not vacate the office it was paid into
grants: recognition, as a bounded percent on an authored allowlist
access, to a shelf, a seat, a contest or a doctrine tier
transmission, which is fit and projects zero modifiers
grants_never: a flat, which is decisive at realm 2 and noise by realm 12 across the 551x ladder
a base-attribute write, which smuggles a member through the gates meant to test them
attributes.why_two_numbers: because a member may hold a high position on thin standing, and that gap is the entire reason an institution is political rather than numeric. Collapsing the two axes into one number would make every promotion an arithmetic event and every demotion a rounding error.

name: Office of the Marshal
summary: The March's highest seat, filled by a three-stage trial the office cannot judge, and it commands passage and nothing else. It exists because a river polity able to count bodies would be a tyranny, so its powers are three verbs about crossings - close the fords, call the levy, judge the boundary - and its recognition allowlist is authored at zero, so the seat grants access and currently projects nothing at all.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/march_of_the_nine_provinces.tres office_marshal
abstract-pattern:ferry-police commands with no jurisdiction over persons
lore search office / marshal / succession returned no prior politics record

duties: be answerable at the crossing rather than at a hall
attributes.recognition_currently_projects_nothing: both allowlist entries are authored at 0.0, so a Marshal is recognised and inert - the shape of every access office in this setting, and the reason recognition and power stayed separable
cannot: levy a seat, which is the central prohibition of the whole institutional model
count a body, which is what the Hollow Measure makes unenforceable in any case
own ground, which is a claim rather than an office
attributes.why_trial_and_not_appointment: an appointed marshal names the next marshal, and the office becomes self-perpetuating. A trialled one hands the court to a judge it does not control, which is the whole defence and costs nothing to state.
attributes.walked_not_rolled: succession advances one authored stage per call and refuses a further step until a period elapses. No random source is consulted, so the outcome is a function of the ledger, a test needs no seeded generator, and no outcome can be convenient to the sitting office.
attributes.why_the_authority_is_passage: geography.widow_run relocates its bed every flood. The one thing a marshal can actually guarantee is that the ford will be found and the bridge held, and every office power in this polity is a restatement of that.

name: Office of the Star Regent
summary: The Court of the Star's highest seat, and the setting's clearest statement that a claim is not a crown. It may name a seat and may not take one: every appointment passes a trial the Regent cannot judge, which is exactly what stops the top office from being self-perpetuating.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/court_of_the_star.tres office_star_regent
abstract-pattern:regencies distinguished from kingship by a refusal
lore search regent / star / office returned no prior politics record

attributes.recognition_currently_projects_nothing: both allowlist entries are authored at 0.0 - including breakthrough chance, which is the most tempting stat in the game to hand a ruler and is therefore exactly the one left at zero
attributes.the_two_stage_gap: named is a state with an occupant and confirmed is a state with a claim; the whole year between them is the office's product, because it is the interval in which a name has to survive being only a name
attributes.only_difference_from_the_marshal: the Regent names and does not take; the Marshal judges a boundary and does not count a body. Neither office can be filled by its own holder, and that symmetry is why the two polities can be neighbours without either being able to annex the other.
attributes.walked_not_rolled: one stage per call, refuses a further step until a period elapses, no random source consulted

name: The Hermit of the Outer Seat
summary: A seat that has never been occupied and is never going to be filled, distinguished from the River Lantern by cause: the Lantern is vacant because its heirs were culled, and this one is vacant because it has no powers to confer and an empty successor parameter to read. Hiding the row would say the office does not exist, so it is kept visible.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/court_of_the_star.tres office_hermit_of_the_outer_seat powers=[] succession_param={}
abstract-pattern:offices retained permanently empty as an institutional confession
lore search hermit / outer seat / perpetual vacancy returned no prior politics record

attributes.why_it_exists: a polity whose highest-adjacent seat has never been occupied is a legible fact about that polity. The row is the record, and an office with an empty allowlist is legal content that projects no modifier at all rather than a bug awaiting an author
attributes.difference_from_the_vacant_lantern_seat: the Lantern could be filled tomorrow by an amendment and this cannot be filled at all, because there is nothing a holder would be able to do. Conflating the two vacancies would erase the only office in the setting that was designed to stay empty
attributes.why_the_empty_parameter_is_the_design: an empty succession map means the appointment procedure has nothing to read, so no appointment can resolve. This is the difference between a seat nobody has taken and a seat nobody was ever able to take, and the setting needs both kinds
attributes.what_it_recognises: nothing, because there is nothing to recognise - the one office in the bible where a claim's entire output is the visible absence

name: The Grain Tariff
summary: The standing agreement that a crossing is paid in grain and never in coin, because grain is the only thing the Mortal Plains produces and a tariff denominated in the payer's own crop cannot be inflated by anyone. It exists because the March's obligation line is two ford dues and one winter grain, and because a state that must be paid in the good it would starve without has no monetary policy available to get wrong.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/march_of_the_nine_provinces.tres claim_march obligation ford_dues=2 winter_grain=1
abstract-pattern:in-kind tolls in non-monetary economies
lore search tariff / treaty / ford dues returned no prior politics record

attributes.never_denominated_in: coin, because the plains mint nothing and a coin tariff would be a tax on a currency issued elsewhere - it would make the March a customs post for somebody else's money
attributes.who_bears_it: the crossing house, which is usually a member of the same counting house that collects the toll, so this is an arrangement inside a house more than a treaty between states. That is why it renews without being voted on
attributes.what_it_is_not: a treaty does not grant a seat and cannot be levied into one. A duty paid at a ford is an obligation term on a claim, and an obligation term is never a position
attributes.lapse: an unsettled term leaves the obligation line open and vacates nothing. A debt is not a vacancy, and the distinction is load-bearing: the River Lantern seat is vacant for a completely different reason and must not be conflated with an unpaid ford
attributes.clock: accrual takes an explicit periods argument from the caller. No record in this institution reads a clock for itself, and the standing it moves is moved by dues actually settled rather than by the passage of time
attributes.anti_inflation_property: a collector cannot raise a grain tariff and gain, because the collector eats from the same field. The only tariff a subsistence polity can safely set is one that costs its own officers as much as its subjects

name: The Reader's Shelf
summary: The Reader of the Law decides which doctrine tier a case may be heard under, which is access and never power: the office opens a shelf and grants nothing on the far side of it. It exists because a highland polity standing on surveyed ground can cite precedent, and a precedent nobody may cite is not a rule but a private opinion.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/court_of_the_star.tres office_law_reader powers read_the_precedent set_a_doctrine_tier
abstract-pattern:doctrine-tier courts that grant standing to argue rather than a result
lore search doctrine / precedent / reader returned no prior politics record

attributes.what_access_means_here: the tier decides which arguments may be heard at all. It does not decide them, and the office cannot use the tier to add a stat, write a stat's base, or introduce a second composer - those three are named because each is a way an access office turns into a power office
attributes.why_comprehension_is_authored_at_zero: comprehension is the right stat to recognise a reader on, and it is left at 0.0. The seat is legible and inert, which is the shape of every access office in this setting and the reason the two axes stayed separable for four generations
attributes.the_limit: a tier set at the top of the range is a refusal of the case, not a higher court. There is no tier from which an appeal succeeds, because a reader who can be appealed to is a judge
attributes.why_it_needs_measured_ground: the Spirit Peaks write spatial law, so a boundary can be walked and cited. Below that tier no precedent survives contact with a distance that changes between two readings, which is the first tier at which citing anything is possible at all
attributes.relation_to_the_unwritten_count: the court needs citable records and organizations.saltledger is organised around records it controls, while civilizations.unfiled_anchorage and cultures.quiet_count are organised around records nobody can hold. The doctrine tier is the institutional expression of that disagreement

name: The Granary Contest
summary: The Quartermaster of the Wold is filled by contest with a quota of three rather than by trial, because the office holds the granaries and recognises nothing else. It exists because an office with an empty allowlist has nothing to be prudent about, so the only thing worth contesting is who is willing to be blamed for opening the store.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/march_of_the_nine_provinces.tres office_quartermaster succession_method=contest quota=3 standing_percent_stats={}
abstract-pattern:contested stewardship of stores in flood economies
lore search contest / quota / granary returned no prior politics record

attributes.why_contest_and_not_trial: a trial measures judgement and a contest measures willingness. The granary's only failure mode is a closed store in a flood year, and that is decided by who is willing rather than by who is wise, so the instrument is chosen to match the risk
attributes.what_three_wins_means: three, because geography.widow_run gives one flood a year and a store opened in three different years has survived one of them. The quota is a sample size and the sample is the river
attributes.the_allowlist_is_the_argument: standing_percent_stats is an empty dictionary, so this office projects no modifier at all. It is legal content, and it is the reason the office can be contested on blame without anybody suspecting it of hiding a bonus
attributes.no_clock: the contest counts wins and not seasons. A caller supplies the periods explicitly, because an institution may not read a clock for itself
what_a_quartermaster_cannot_do: open the granary without the contest on record
hold any other office, since a contest is not a qualification
attributes.why_the_office_exists: because a polity that governs passage must also be the polity that survives a flood, and the flood is the only event on this tier that arrives on a schedule nobody can argue with

name: The Unjudgeable Trial
summary: The rule that every appointment in both polities passes a trial the naming office cannot judge, authored by an attempt that came very nearly to filling four vacant immortal seats by decree. It exists because the highest office here may name a seat and may not take one, and that single sentence is the whole defence against a polity that promotes itself.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:history.decree_the_unfilled_seats states_recognised=3 prohibitions + history.collapse_the_refused_seating
abstract-pattern:office law written as the scar of a failed attempt
lore search treaty / succession / vacancy returned no prior politics record

attributes.instrument: appointments routed through a trial the office cannot judge

the_three_states.vacant_flag: the office exists and its value is absent
the_three_states.refusal: a named reason, never free text

attributes.origin: an earlier attempt to fill the vacant seats by appointment, which is why the rule reads like a scar rather than a principle
attributes.walked_not_rolled: advances one authored stage per call and refuses a further step until a period elapses; no random source is consulted
attributes.what_it_does_not_do: it does not make a trial fair. It makes the outcome a function of a ledger rather than a decision taken after the fact by the office that would benefit, and that is a much smaller and much more defensible promise
attributes.the_relationship_to_vacancy: the rule is also what makes an unfilled seat legible. Because no one may self-appoint and no vacant seat may be certified empty, an empty seat stays empty on the record rather than quietly becoming nobody's business

name: The Trial of the Ford
summary: The Marshal's three stages - sworn at the ford, held the bridge, named by the March - in that order and never another. It exists because the Widow Run relocates its bed far enough between floods to move every settlement on it, so an oath sworn at a crossing has to be re-earned against a river that will not be where it was.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/march_of_the_nine_provinces.tres office_marshal succession_param.stages + geography.widow_run
abstract-pattern:apprenticeship oaths re-sworn against a moving site
lore search ford / oath / trial returned no prior politics record

attributes.why_this_order: the ford proves a candidate can find the crossing at all, which on unmeasured ground is the actual skill; the bridge proves they can hold it against a flood that will move it; and only then does a name carry anything worth confirming
attributes.no_randomness: the outcome is a function of the ledger, so no seeded generator is needed to test it and no result can be convenient to the sitting office
attributes.geography_bound: the first stage is administered at civilizations.ford_assembly, not by the office the stage produces, because a stage cannot be administered by the office it creates
attributes.uncovered_boundary: a candidate who holds the bridge while the river is in flood has held the thing the stage names, and no rule forbids counting it. The Flood Reading is an unresolved question, not a defined exception
attributes.why_not_appointed: naming by the March would make the second stage decorative, since the body that names is the body that benefits

name: The Vacant River Lantern
summary: The Keeper of the River Lantern, unfilled for two generations, written as a seat that exists and has no value rather than as a zero. Its succession is an heir under the March charter, and the charter names a line - so the vacancy is not an oversight but an arithmetic result of a house that culled its own branches to stop paying for siblings.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:game/data/nation/march_of_the_nine_provinces.tres office_lantern_keeper plus history.decree_the_branch_cull plus cultures.debt_line
abstract-pattern:offices left empty by an earlier demographic decision
lore search vacancy / lantern / heir returned no prior politics record

attributes.represented_as: a row that exists and whose value is absent
attributes.never: a zero, a hidden row, or a deleted office - all three would say the office does not exist when it demonstrably does
attributes.why_vacant: the charter names a line, and history.decree_the_branch_cull narrowed that line deliberately, under debt, to stop paying for siblings. An heir succession running through a culled line is a succession with no eligible heir, and the vacancy is the cull read back out of the charter two generations later
attributes.cost_of_the_vacancy: the beacons are unlit. A river with no lit crossing is a river nobody can find after dark, which is the March's actual exposure - not a power vacuum but an operating liability, and the only office in the polity whose absence has a physical consequence
attributes.who_may_fill_it: anybody the charter reaches. Standing qualifies nobody here, because a succession does not read standing - which is the position/standing split doing visible work rather than merely being stated
attributes.how_a_cull_becomes_a_political_fact: cultures.debt_line culled branches for debt reasons because a hundred-year body with a realm-eight ceiling retires rather than advances, so attrition was never available as a release valve. The cull was economic; this seat is where it was paid
attributes.what_would_fill_it: a charter amendment, or a line that has not yet been culled. Neither is a promotion and neither moves standing.

name: The Visitor Offices
summary: The class of mortal-tier offices that by construction can only be filled by non-residents, and the reason a polity on the lowest tier is a caretaker government rather than a state. It exists because the Mortal Plains licenses plants and beasts and admits no humanoid, so the population that holds office on the plains is not drawn from the population the plains produces.

provenance.author: w3-politics
basis: authored-game-data:geography.mortal_plains faction_id body_dao, resident forms plant+beast, local_practitioners 0 at cairn_field + history.schism_the_naming_of_homes
abstract-pattern:colonial administrations with no local recruitment pipeline
lore search office / visitor / caretaker returned no prior politics record

attributes.the_class: every office on a tier whose seated life law admits no humanoid
attributes.consequence_one: an officeholder on the plains is a visitor, so the polity's own continuity is a question of external supply of people rather than of local institution, and the institution can be closed by people who have never visited it
attributes.consequence_two: no household on the plains can succeed anyone to a plains office by being of the plains, which turns every succession rule into an immigration procedure. The Marshal's trial of the ford is administered at a crossing whose two banks have no right to name a candidate
attributes.consequence_three: the levy the Marshal may call is answered by people who may say no. That is not defiance and not lawlessness; it is the absence of any obligation owed by a population that is not a population of this polity
attributes.rotation_is_the_constitution: a fixed term with no renewal clause for the same body, because renewal is the only thing a visitor officeholder would actually want and the only thing the tier cannot afford
attributes.what_it_is_not: not a claim, not a standing and not a second institution model. It is the same three states with one condition added - the residential condition - and the addition costs nothing because nothing about position or standing depended on it
attributes.the_temptation_it_names: a plains office that recognised its holder on the body would be buying a loyalty the tier has no way to keep. The bounded recognition percent is what makes that cost explicit and finite instead of an open-ended drain
attributes.why_this_is_a_class_and_not_an_office: because the same arithmetic applies to every seat on the tier, and recording it once is the only way the distinction from a normal polity stays visible instead of being re-derived at each seat
